# turn.js — evaluation copy, not cleared for release

These files are **third-party and proprietary**. They are here so the
page-turn prototype at `/prototype/turn` can be run and judged on a real
device. They are not used by the app itself.

| | |
|---|---|
| Library | turn.js, 4th release (4.1.0) |
| Source | turnjs.com, downloaded as `turnjs4.zip` |
| Copyright | © 2012 Emmanuel Garcia — **All rights reserved** |
| Licence text | Not included in the download. It points to `turnjs.com/license.txt` |
| Last modified | December 2012 |

## Before this can ship

The licence has not been read or agreed. The header says "All rights
reserved" and the licence file is not in the distribution, so the terms are
unknown to this repository. turn.js's 4th release is the commercial one.

**Someone has to obtain and accept the licence before any of this reaches a
child.** If that does not happen, delete this directory and the
`/prototype/turn` route with it — nothing else depends on them.

Also bundled here because turn.js requires them:

- `jquery.min.1.7.js` — jQuery 1.7, MIT
- `modernizr.2.5.3.min.js` — Modernizr 2.5.3, MIT/BSD
